description: An open turn as its agent reads it: the act it answers (its id is the turn's address), with the act's context as an index, the calls it may make, and how each call it made so far ended. Nothing in it is the data of a context entry, which `turn_read` reads by its locator.

items.description: One call an agent made in its turn, and how it ended.

call_id.description: The id its host pinned on the call, unique within its turn: a call made again with it returns this call rather than running twice.

index.description: The call's place in the turn, from 0.

input_digest.description: `sha256:` over the canonical JSON of the call's input (`runx.stable-json.v1`), so a host that recorded a call before making it can prove which call sits at this index.

anyOf.description: The call ran and succeeded.

artifacts.description: Each packet output as a project artifact of the run, by output name: a reference a later call passes in place of the packet.

anyOf.description: The call ran and failed, with its receipt; or it failed before it could run.
Admission refused the call; nothing ran.

The call has not settled. `waiting` is what it waits on, each request by its address: its own ask or approval, its retry while its effect is unconfirmed, or what the child run it started waits on, including that run's open turns. The call settles when those are answered.

free_text.description: Whether the person may answer in their own words.

options.description: What the person may choose, the recommended first.

gate.description: The gate an approval request asks a person to pass, and why.

payload.description: What executes once the gate is approved, when it is at most 64 KiB. A host recomputes `summary.payload_digest` over it before it offers Approve; the request's digest binds it with the rest of the gate.

payload_artifact.description: What executes, when it is larger: a project artifact whose bytes are its canonical JSON.
payload_artifact.title: ProjectArtifact

summary.description: Shallow summary payload. `payload_digest` in it is the stable digest (`runx.stable-json.v1`) of what executes once the gate is approved.

anyOf.description: A step or call waits to run again. A bounded retry (`retry_after_seconds` above zero) is runx's own: the driver that reaches it after the delay runs it. resend.description: Whether a claimed call can be sent again with the same input: its provider deduplicates it, or it only reads. One that cannot is never resent; its run can only be closed with the call unconfirmed.

anyOf.description: A call reached a paid runner and waits on the person's exact decision: they answer `approved` and the method they pay with (`choice`).

purchase.description: What a person decides when a call reaches a paid runner: one quote's exact offer version, seller and price, and each payment method that can pay it. The request's digest binds all of it, so an answer pays only this quote, before it expires.

methods.description: Never empty: a call no method can pay fails instead of asking.

anyOf.description: The account's runx balance, which covers the price: the price moves inside runx's ledger, with no settlement per call.
